model.stratum: Attachment transport and readout descent on explicitly lifted rotor/reverser histories in the declared Clifford module. Continuous path and starting lift remain input data, not consequences of a discrete word.
model.next_falsifier: The same primitive matrix e2 admits angular lifts differing by 2*pi; LL and the empty word share a clock reading but not history. An asserted native elapsed-time observable must specify its path, frame and comparison policy instead of descending from endpoint data.
